templates.name: Code Review
templates.description: Review a diff or set of files
templates.template:
## Review focus areas

- [ ] Security (injection, secrets in env vars, no hardcoded credentials)
- [ ] Domain purity (no I/O imports in engine.py or models.py)
- [ ] Test coverage (happy path, edge cases, error conditions)
- [ ] AGENTS.md conventions (naming, Pydantic v2 patterns, typing)
- [ ] Definition of Done compliance
- [ ] Web UI: composition thresholds (≤8 useState, ≤300 LOC, ErrorDisplay on every catch)

## Code

{diff_or_file_paths}
